subject: Stakeholder checkpoint: data handling & deployment mode decisions
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tran <liz.tran@acme.com>, ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder checkpoint: data handling & deployment mode decisions

Hi all —

Following up from yesterday's sync. Attached is the MAP draft (ACME_MAP_v0.9.pdf) with our current evaluation plan and proposed close timeline. This week's checkpoint focuses on two decision areas that need alignment before we proceed to pilot:

1) Deployment mode: VPC-managed hosted vs on-prem appliance. Key constraints called out by ACME: network isolation for PHI-adjacent workloads and a requirement for customer-managed KMS in the on-prem case.

2) Data retention & PII handling: ACME has asked for a 30/90/365 retention matrix by artifact (raw transcripts, embeddings, logs) and a clear path to purge on request.

Please review the highlighted pages in the MAP and confirm or flag any blockers. Specific asks for this week:
- ACME: confirm whether the pilot requires full on-prem (appliance) or VPC with dedicated tenancy for phase 1.
- Legal (Lauren): advise if the proposed 90-day transient cache policy is acceptable for embeddings used in reranking.
- Ops (Jordan): validate whether our KMS/HSM integration timeline (see deployment_modes_matrix.xlsx) meets ACME gating.

I've included an initial suggested action-item table below. We'll capture answers in the MAP and target a final decision by EOD Tue, 2027-04-06.

Action items (draft)
- ACME to confirm deployment preference — owner: Lisa Tran — due: 2027-04-05
- Redwood legal to sign off on retention matrix — owner: Lauren Bishop — due: 2027-04-05
- Infra to validate KMS feasibility & timeline — owner: Jordan Blake — due: 2027-04-06

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v0.9.pdf, deployment_modes_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,

Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
nsharma@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lisa Tran <liz.tran@acme.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder checkpoint: data handling & deployment mode decisions

Thanks Nikhil — appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses inline: 

> ACME: confirm whether the pilot requires full on-prem (appliance) or VPC with dedicated tenancy for phase 1.

For pilot: ACME prefers VPC with dedicated tenancy and customer-managed KMS (not fully on-prem). The reasons: faster time-to-value and our procurement team can't approve hardware in Q2. We do need network isolation (private subnets + no public egress by default).

> Data retention & PII handling

We need the retention matrix by artifact as you requested. Also, on purge: ACME requires an API-level purge capability and a signed SLA for purge completion (30 days max for full purge of embeddings/logs).

I've added a note that Security will do a short questionnaire on KMS integration details (they're CC'd). Attaching our internal security checklist as context (not for publish).

Regards,
Lisa Tran
Product Security Lead — ACME Corp
liz.tran@acme.com

To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Lisa Tran <liz.tran@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder checkpoint: data handling & deployment mode decisions

Thanks — looping legal input. A few items we need to firm up before sign-off:

- Embeddings retention: if embeddings are used in downstream reranking and cached for latency, we need a contract clause that defines maximum cache window and a technical control that allows programmatic invalidation. 90 days might be acceptable for non-sensitive datasets but must be 30 days for datasets tagged containing PII.

- Purge SLA: ACME's 30-day full purge SLA is tight but can be included as a commercial term if Ops provides an auditable purge workflow (logging + verification). We need Jordan to confirm logging/audit retention for those purge ops.

- On deployment mode: VPC with customer-managed KMS is reasonable. We need an exception path documented if ACME later requests on-prem — include an estimated timeline and cost delta in the MAP.

I've attached a retention_policy_draft.docx with sample contract language and a short checklist for audit evidence. Please review and incorporate into the MAP.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tran <liz.tran@acme.com>, ACME Security <security@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder checkpoint: data handling & deployment mode decisions — agreed actions

Great—thank you, everyone, for fast turnaround. Summary of decisions and owners (we'll update the MAP and send a final v1 on Wed):

Decisions reached:
- Pilot deployment mode: VPC (dedicated tenancy) with customer-managed KMS. ACME confirmed no hardware procurement for pilot (Lisa).
- Retention: adopt the artifact matrix approach. For any artifact tagged PII, retention will be 30 days; otherwise default 90 days for embeddings, 365 for logs, subject to legal clause (Lauren).
- Purge: Redwood will provide an API-driven purge mechanism and operational purge SLA of 30 days for full purge; purge ops will be auditable with logs retained for 1 year.

Action items (finalized)
- Lisa (ACME) — confirm network isolation specifics (VPC subnets, egress policy) — due 2027-04-07 — EXTERNAL OWNER
- Jordan Blake — validate KMS integration plan & confirm logging for purge operations; produce a short runbook — due 2027-04-06
- Lauren Bishop — finalize contract language for retention/purge clauses and provide copy for MAP — due 2027-04-06
- Marissa Cole — update MAP doc with final matrix and upload to the shared Drive — due 2027-04-07

Attachments referenced: retention_policy_draft.docx, deployment_modes_matrix.xlsx, ACME_MAP_v0.9.pdf

Next checkpoint: Wed 2027-04-07 09:00 PT — 30 min — goal: finalize MAP v1 for pilot sign-off.

Thanks — Nikhil
